git ls-tree default format:
%(objectmode) %(objecttype) %(objectname)%x09%(path)

git ls-tree -r: "Recurse into sub-trees."
git ls-tree -z: "\0 line termination on output and do not quote filenames."
git ls-tree --full-tree: "Do not limit the listing to the current working directory."

git fast-import modes:
100644: "A normal (not-executable) file."
100755: "A normal, but executable, file."

git show: "For plain blobs, it shows the plain contents."
gitrevisions: "<rev>:<path>, e.g. HEAD:README, master:./README"
git --no-replace-objects: "Do not use replacement refs to replace Git objects."
